sections.name: Hero
sections.copy: Life-stage marketing · Southeast Europe · START is Care Direct's family of programs for the moments people begin something new: a first baby, a first school day, university, a wedding, retirement. We put your product in their hands, with a guide they keep and a follow-up that turns trial into a relationship.
sections.proof: Stats: 12 life-stage moments, one program family · 5 countries across Southeast Europe · ~80,000 new mothers a year in Greece · 85% of new mothers in Bulgaria reached yearly for Sudocrem. Buttons: Find your START · How a START works. Merged from the START site design.
